# SILO

> Read-only API and MCP for Brazilian public financial data, including company statements, funds, credit, prices, derivatives, macro and market positioning.

## Start here with v2

The REST API and MCP v2 are live in preview. Anonymous data calls need no key. To sign in, configure a user access token as `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. See the Quickstart for the first call and the skill for the agent workflow.

- [v2 quickstart](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/quickstart.md): Discover resources, resolve an identifier, query data, check coverage and connect an agent.
- [Agent skill](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/skill.md): Authentication, tool selection, pagination, empty results, partial results and provenance.
- [REST v2 resource index](https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/functions/v1/silo-api/v2/): 14 resources. Add `?help=all` to a resource path for parameters, kinds and defaults.
- [MCP v2](https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/functions/v1/silo-mcp-v2): Remote Streamable HTTP. Call `tools/list` to discover the 14 tools. Start with `silo_search` to resolve identifiers and `silo_coverage` to check freshness.
- [v2 catalog](https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/functions/v1/silo-api/v2/coverage?kind=catalog): Metric definitions, applicability, constraints and regime breaks.
- [v2 cheatsheet](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/cheatsheet.md): Shared parameters, resources, defaults and tool arguments.
- [v2 for researchers](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/researchers.md): Point-in-time queries, survivorship, adjustments, reproducibility and citation.
- [v2 OpenAPI](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/openapi.json): Machine-readable REST contract for the 14 resources.

- [Agent onboarding](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/agents.md): Give an agent the SILO skill and a reproducible research workflow.
- [MCP connection guide](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/mcp.md): Configure Streamable HTTP and make the first tool calls.

- [v2 operation directory](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/endpoints.md): 74 operations mapped to the existing REST resources and MCP tools.
- [v2 authentication](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/authentication.md): Anonymous, user-session and revocable integration-key access.
- [v2 pagination and errors](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/v2/responses.md): Complete, partial, empty and failed responses.

## Existing v1 integrations

The pages below cover PostgREST and the legacy MCP. Use the v2 links above for gateway parameters, authentication behavior and limits.


- [SILO](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/index.md): What the API serves, and the shortest path from nothing to an answer.
- [v1 quickstart](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/quickstart.md): Get the publishable key, make your first request, and read the response — in under a minute.
- [v1 conventions & limits](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/conventions.md): PostgREST contract. Base URL, auth tiers and every ceiling, the 1,000-row cap and the p_after cursor protocol, null and not-applicable semantics, the FIDC 2025-01 regime break, freshness columns, and error behavior.
- [v1 Python SDK](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/sdk.md): silo-client — a thin, honest Python client over the read API: one method per endpoint, a capped response raises, views page, nothing is fabricated.
- [v1 agent guide](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/agents.md): The operator guide for coding agents — what to read, how to get a token, the first live call, and how to screen a whole fund family.
- [v1 MCP server](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/mcp.md): Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to SILO over MCP: one read-only tool per API endpoint, no key, no signup, errors passed through verbatim. Live at https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/functions/v1/silo-mcp.
- [Data inventory](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/data-inventory.md): What we ingest, what we don't, and what we hold but don't serve.
- [Market coverage](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/market-coverage.md): What exists, how far back it goes, how often it updates — and the one dataset that is a ratchet.
- [Known limitations](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/known-limitations.md): What the API does not do yet and what is planned — sector-specific charts of accounts, tickers that resolve to nothing, the duplicated ITR spans, unadjusted prices.

## Guides

- [Your first screen](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/guides/first-screen.md): From a publishable key to a real chart of Brazilian market data, in four calls.
- [Paging without losing rows](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/guides/pagination.md): Three different ways a response gets cut, and only one of them tells you.
- [Reading a fundamental](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/guides/fundamentals.md): A listed company's financial statements end to end — and the two conventions that will silently corrupt your numbers.
- [Pulling a research universe](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/guides/research.md): The universe, adjusted and total-return prices, the benchmark, fundamentals as they were known and macro: the calls, in order, and where each one can quietly mislead.
- [Sheets and Excel](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/spreadsheets.md): CSV into Google Sheets (Apps Script) and Excel (Power Query). `IMPORTDATA` does not work: it cannot ask for CSV. Server behaviour measured live; snippets marked where not run.

## Market data

- [Quotes](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/quotes.md): B3 cash-market quotes — the unadjusted api.quotes view plus quote_history (with adjusted and total-return closes) and quote_latest.
- [Cash instruments](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/instruments.md): One endpoint per B3 cash instrument type — equities, BDRs, units, fund quotas and other cash paper, each with both lot sizes.
- [Options](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/options.md): B3 equity options as published — one session's chain for a codneg prefix, or one series' daily history.
- [Termo](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/termo.md): B3 forward (termo) contracts as published — one code's daily history, term included in the grain.
- [Securities lending](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/lending.md): B3's securities-lending book — short interest and % of float, the sector aggregate, the trade tape and the brokerage on each leg. A ratchet: ~21 business days at the source, no archive.
- [Investor flow](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/flows.md): Daily buy/sell/net flow by investor type, differenced from B3's month-to-date participation snapshots and published T+2.
- [COTAHIST Dictionary](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/cotahist-dictionary.md): Every field of B3's COTAHIST register-01 record, the TPMERC and CODBDI code tables, and how Silo maps them — verified against the rb3 reference layout.

## Funds and credit

- [Funds](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/funds.md): CVM fund registry and monthly fundamentals — the api.funds view plus search_funds, fund_profile, and fund_nav.
- [Fund holdings](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/holdings.md): What a fund owns, and which funds own a ticker — the one edge joining the fund universe to the quote tape.
- [FIDC concentration](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/fidc.md): Who a receivables fund buys from, who owes it, what sector the book is in and how BACEN grades it — informe tabs I, VIII, II and X, served as filed.
- [FIDC tranches and aging](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/fidc-structure.md): Inside a receivables fund's capital structure and credit book — each tranche's quotas, return and promised vs realised performance with its subscriptions and redemptions, and the aging ladder of what is owed. Informe tabs X and VI, as filed, from 2025.
- [Fund documents and restatements](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/fnet-documents.md): B3 Fundos.NET's document register — every document filed for a fund, each version with its own id, the restatements (RE voluntary, RC CVM-required) paired with the version they replaced, and, for FIDC monthly informes, the fields each restatement changed. Metadata and diffs with a source link, as published.
- [Filing-behaviour screens](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/filing-screens.md): How funds file, not what they hold — unusual FNET restatements, monthly informes delivered past the deadline Resolução CVM 175 states (cited on every row), and registered funds that stopped filing. Signals, not verdicts.
- [Company events](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/company-events.md): A listed company's IPE filings to CVM — fatos relevantes, comunicados, assembly material — as filed, one row per protocol, each with its link on CVM's RAD. From 2015.
- [Macro series and PTAX](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/macro.md): BACEN's Selic target and daily rate, CDI, IGP-M, INPC, old-rule poupança, the SGS dollar and euro, monthly GDP and PTAX buy/sell per currency — as published, unit on every row.
- [DI and dollar futures, and B3 reference curves](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/rates.md): Every DI1, DOL and WDO futures contract per session from 2018 (DI1 quoted in rate, the dollar futures in BRL per USD 1,000), and B3's reference curves (DI x pré, onshore dollar coupon, IPCA coupon) per vertex from 2008, as B3 publishes them; the long end of each curve is B3's extrapolation.
- [Forensic screens](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/screens.md): Seven public-filing screens — FIDC zombie growth, evergreen aging and delinquency drivers, captive FIIs, overdue CRI/CRA, dormant funds. Signals, not verdicts: every row carries the screen and the params it crossed.
- [Debenture market observations and implied rate](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/credit.md): B3's traded debenture prices as held in the warehouse (credit_market_history), and the yield calculated from each average PU (credit_implied_rate). Observations and a calculation, never a quote.
- [Portfolio comparison functions](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/portfolio.md): Fee peers, class return distributions, ETF equivalents and the CRA, CRI and debenture value series behind a portfolio diagnosis, served as stored.
- [ANBIMA classes](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/anbima.md): The industry's own benchmark series — AUM, net flows, returns and fund counts per ANBIMA class, as the Boletim de Fundos publishes them.

## Macro

- [Inflation](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/inflation.md): IPCA as BACEN and IBGE publish it — headline, IPCA-15, the BCB cores, monitored and free prices, the nine expenditure groups, and IBGE's whole item tree with the weights that say what moved the index.

## Companies

- [Company financials](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/financials.md): Filed income statements, balance sheets and cash flows for Brazilian listed companies — resolved by ticker, CNPJ or CVM code.

## Cross-cutting endpoints

- [Panel](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/panel.md): The researcher endpoint — long (id, date, metric, value) observations mixing B3 tickers and CVM fund CNPJs in one call. The API's one primitive.
- [Lookup](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/lookup.md): Resolve a ticker, ISIN, CNPJ, fund name, or company name to the identifiers this API accepts.
- [Coverage](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/api-docs/coverage.md): Latest loaded date per dataset — check it before you claim anything is current.

## For machines

- [skill.md](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/skill.md): Connect an agent to v2, authenticate when needed, and verify and cite the result.
- [Docs MCP](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/mcp): Search and read these pages over MCP. No login.
- [v1 catalog()](https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/catalog): `POST` with `{}` and an `apikey` header. The contract as JSON — `limits`, `metrics`, `applicability`, `regime_breaks`, `constraints`, and a `version` saying what the server is actually serving.
- [v1 Data API](https://zcjbtpxuhdekpwcxmepn.supabase.co/rest/v1/): The live base URL. Views are `GET /<view>`; functions are `POST /rpc/<function>`.

## v1 OpenAPI Spec

- [openapi.json](https://octo-98895abd.mintlify.site/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 covering every granted view and function, generated from the live Postgres catalog by `scripts/gen_openapi.py` and guarded against drift in both directions by `tests/test_openapi_spec.py`. Nothing in it is hand-maintained.

## Optional

- [Notebooks](https://github.com/PedroDnT/SILO-BZ/tree/main/notebooks): Eleven runnable notebooks, `00_start_here` through `10_dustin_br_model` — each one a real question answered end to end.
- [Sign in](https://silo-bz-deloslabs.vercel.app/signin.html): GitHub OAuth. Returns a user token that raises the tier ceilings for about an hour.
- [Dashboard](https://silo-bz-deloslabs.vercel.app/): The Evidence.dev site — fund health plus B3 market, short-interest, investor-flow and macro pages. A nightly static snapshot, not the API.
- [Repository](https://github.com/PedroDnT/SILO-BZ): The ingestion pipeline that writes the warehouse these pages read.
